'''Alan Sagan DS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Alan Sagan]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-15210">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15210 DeckTech post 15210], DeckTech (Alan "Serpent" Sagan, 12 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15210/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15210/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Alan Sagan]]
* '''Published:''' 12 April 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 WIADM Sagan DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' I made this deck a bit after ref2 came out.  It was good at beating WYS, and no one knew what to expect.  it went undefeated in 3 tournaments.

== Original post ==

'''WYS is a dirty MoFo'''
* '''Author:''' Alan "Serpent" Sagan
* '''Published:''' April 12, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' I made this deck a bit after ref2 came out.  It was good at beating WYS, and no one knew what to expect.  it went undefeated in 3 tournaments.

=== Strategy ===

==== Update ====

Doesnt drain well my dam a$$.  Two in space, Tthree per one icon site, 3 for tat occ.  14 per turn biatch.  And unless your dumb, this OWNS space.  you don?t just deploy your one thing at a time, you wait till your ready.  And you get 11 force on your own, which is plenty for this.  every LS deck gives you at least 3.  And drain sites.

This is pretty basic.  Plays like a LS throne room mains, but has some damn good damage potential.  Dominates everywhere.

I might write a better strat section sometime, but this is an older deck, i haven?t played it for like 2 months, so I don?t want to screw it up )
